args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
- Newsletter: Ironbark Tooling's latest issue covers "Cold-chain logistics in 2026," highlighting the main article and its companion piece.
- Linked article: Temperature excursions fell 30% when carriers shared live sensor data; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than from reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece (registered via daniel.ferreira@northwind.example): Pilots using this approach cut insurance/claims by roughly a quarter.
